# MakerLens

> Free browser tools that look inside RPG Maker games. Everything runs 100% client-side: game files are read by the browser and never uploaded. No install, no account.

## Tools

- [MakerLens Assets](https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/): preview and download the images and audio of RPG Maker MV, MZ, XP, VX, VX Ace, 2000 and 2003 games, encrypted or not (.rpgmvp, .rpgmvo, .png_, .ogg_, .m4a_, .rgssad, .rgss2a, .rgss3a, .xyz). Filter by image size or audio length, hide duplicate files, download a folder as a ZIP. Details: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/llms.txt · FAQ: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/faq.html
- [MakerLens Events](https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/events/): see the event commands of RPG Maker MV, MZ, VX Ace, VX, XP, 2000 and 2003 maps and common events (dialogue, choices, conditions, switches, variables, labels and jumps) as an interactive flow graph, play dialogue scenes with their pictures and sound, search by name, and start scenes from your own save file. Read-only. Details: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/events/llms.txt · FAQ: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/events/faq.html

## Who it's for

- Assets: modders and translators working with the rights holder's permission, developers and artists recovering their own work, anyone who wants to look at a game's images and music without installing software.
- Events: guide and wiki writers, dataminers and speedrunners (ending and hidden-route conditions), translators who need a line's branch, developers reviewing tangled events.

Not for editing, repackaging or redistributing games.

## Quick answers

- To open `.rpgmvp`, `.png_`, `.ogg_` or `.rgss3a` files: use MakerLens Assets, select the game folder or the archive; the key is read from the game.
- To see dialogue, choices, switches and variables of any RPG Maker game (2000 to MZ) without the editor: use MakerLens Events and open the game folder (or its `data/` folder). To watch a cutscene, press Preview on a scene.
- To open the same game in both tools: use the Assets | Events switch in the header (Chrome or Edge); the folder stays on your device.
- Files are never uploaded; there is no account and nothing to install. Both tools are free and open source (MIT).

## Privacy and legal

- Privacy (one page for both tools: files never leave the device; what the anonymous counter and the optional feedback form do): https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/privacy.html
- Legal (intended use, user responsibility, takedown requests): https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/legal.html
